description: Motion transfer: re-perform a reference video's motion with a different person/character (supply their image). The reference clip drives the movement; the image supplies the identity. Paid render, billed per output second (the output is as long as the reference clip, 3-30s); a 5s clip takes about 5 minutes. Runs on the Pro tier by default: 1080p, and the person really handles the object the reference performer handles.

image.description: the actor/character image URL (who should appear); a real person’s photo confirms their likeness consent

orientation.description: which aspect to keep: the video's (default) or the image's

tier.description: 'pro' (default): 1080p and real hand-object interaction. 'standard': about 25% fewer credits and faster, but 720p, and it tends to mime a held object with empty hands. hermoso_capabilities lists the exact credits for both

video.description: the reference video whose motion to re-perform

name: recast_motion
title: Recast motion
